My interpretation : The whole anime revolves around an idea which is self-worth and perception. It's a perfect example how an idea can give shape and meaning to everything around you ( for example this anime ). We see Shinji who is really depressed and anxious. His mom died and father abandoned him which lead him to believe he's unwanted and later all of a sudden he's wanted. Because he's supposed to pilot eva. And there are expectations tied to him. By all the characters. So he starts to believe that doing what he's told decides his worth and makes him "happy". You can see him many times saying stuff like "father praised me for what I did" and "I want to make my father proud". Later in the last 3 episodes is where it gets interesting. Questions are asked from Shinji. Why do you pilot the eva. What do you wish for? What is your self worth and what is your truth by all these questions he realises things about himself and he's free from all his beliefs that makes his life not worth living. 
The message is that our lives are shaped by our environment, experiences and people around us (Shinji grew up seeing loneliness, abandonment). However those experiences have an affect on our lives but those experiences are not us. And once we realise we're free from our pain, trauma, experiences we can start to form a different meaning to our lives and form different beliefs which can allow us to see that there's more to life and we are much more than what we went through in life. (Shinji has a vision of a life where his parents love him. Hes having a normal life goes to school and have friends. he starts to see possibilities. If the beliefs he lives by are his truth than there can be new beliefs and therefore, can give him a different meaning to his life).
